name: ascii-text
title: ASCII text
description: Display type drawn as ASCII art in any charset, with an optional decode, scan or wipe reveal, while the real text stays in the page.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble text
description: Text whose characters cycle through katakana, braille, CP437, PETSCII or symbol glyphs and settle left to right, without moving the layout.

name: dissolve-text
title: Dissolve text
description: Text that assembles out of a glyph density ramp and dissolves back into it, one character or word at a time.

name: ascii-number
title: ASCII number
description: A big number drawn in block, half-block, braille or box-drawing digits that counts to its value with tabular alignment and locale formatting.
